WITH committee_cycles AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT DISTINCT s.cycle,
            d.committee_id
           FROM money_donor_snapshots d
             JOIN money_import_scans s ON s.id = d.scan_id
        ), winners AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT committee_cycles.cycle,
            committee_cycles.committee_id,
            money_published_scan('donors'::text, committee_cycles.cycle, committee_cycles.committee_id) AS scan_id
           FROM committee_cycles
        )
 SELECT d.id,
    d.donor_name,
    d.name,
    d.donor_type,
    d.state,
    d.amount,
    d.relationship_strength,
    d.candidate_id,
    d.candidate_name,
    d.committee_name,
    d.occupation,
    d.employer,
    d.city,
    d.source,
    d.source_updated_at,
    d.created_at,
    d.updated_at,
    d.committee_id,
    d.website_url,
    d.linkedin_url,
    d.x_url,
    d.facebook_url,
    d.phone,
    d.address_line1,
    d.address_line2,
    d.postal_code,
    d.contact_source,
    d.contact_verified,
    d.contribution_count,
    d.cycle
   FROM donors d
  WHERE d.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'fec_schedule_a'::text OR NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM money_import_checkpoints c
          WHERE c.lane = 'donors'::text AND c.cycle = d.cycle AND c.published_scan_id IS NOT NULL))
UNION ALL
 SELECT donor.id,
    donor.donor_name,
    donor.name,
    donor.donor_type,
    donor.state,
    donor.amount,
    donor.relationship_strength,
    donor.candidate_id,
    donor.candidate_name,
    donor.committee_name,
    donor.occupation,
    donor.employer,
    donor.city,
    donor.source,
    donor.source_updated_at,
    donor.created_at,
    donor.updated_at,
    donor.committee_id,
    donor.website_url,
    donor.linkedin_url,
    donor.x_url,
    donor.facebook_url,
    donor.phone,
    donor.address_line1,
    donor.address_line2,
    donor.postal_code,
    donor.contact_source,
    donor.contact_verified,
    donor.contribution_count,
    donor.cycle
   FROM winners w
     JOIN money_donor_snapshots d ON d.scan_id = w.scan_id AND d.committee_id = w.committee_id
     JOIN money_import_checkpoints c ON c.published_scan_id = d.scan_id
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_record(NULL::donors, d.payload || jsonb_build_object('id', - d.row_id, 'amount', d.amount, 'contribution_count', d.contributions, 'source_updated_at', c.published_at, 'updated_at', c.published_at)) donor(id, donor_name, name, donor_type, state, amount, relationship_strength, candidate_id, candidate_name, committee_name, occupation, employer, city, source, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at, committee_id, website_url, linkedin_url, x_url, facebook_url, phone, address_line1, address_line2, postal_code, contact_source, contact_verified, contribution_count, cycle);
winner_function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.money_published_scan(request_lane text, request_cycle integer, request_committee text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT c.published_scan_id FROM money_import_checkpoints c JOIN money_import_scans s ON s.id=c.published_scan_id
 WHERE c.lane=request_lane AND c.cycle=request_cycle AND c.published_scan_id IS NOT NULL
 AND (c.scope_key='national' OR c.committees ? request_committee)
 ORDER BY s.cutoff DESC,c.published_at DESC,c.scope_key LIMIT 1
$function$
